answer: Neighborhood Distinctness Quotient. Each agent's message forwarding is scored by how many distinct topological clusters its outbound neighbors span, measured over a rolling zephyr of recent epochs. Sybil clones created by one operator share neighbor sets, so their combined distinctness collapses. Below a threshold, messages route through a lantern relay that adds latency and caps fan-out per epoch. To clear the threshold, an attacker must seed each clone with genuinely separate connections and sustain them until dawn of every scoring window,
